svg.text: CloudBridge: hub-and-spoke on AWS + Azure, DNS with no single point of failure

g.text: N-1 what-if: single points of failure
eBGP 64512 ↔ 65515 · ECMP both ways · ~12 ms RTT
MSS clamped to 1350 (Azure gateway) · path MTU 1422
AKS spoke VNet 10.20.0.0/20 · UDR 0/0 → hub firewall
Orange: AWS user path · Blue: Azure user path · Red: through a firewall · Black: 4 IPsec/BGP tunnels · Purple: MindBridge AI (reads only, never changes anything)
